newsitem.title: JAPAN: Austria's OKB launches 5.6% yen/A$ samurais - Nomura.
newsitem.headline: Austria's OKB launches 5.6% yen/A$ samurais - Nomura.

text.p: Austria's Oesterreichische Kontrollbank AG (OKB) on Friday launched 30 billion yen worth of 5.60 percent two-year yen/Australian dollar dual currency samurai bonds, lead-manager Nomura Securities said.
The bonds are guaranteed by the Austrian government.
They were priced at par and will mature on September 28, 1998, with twice-yearly coupon payments.
Holders of the samurai bonds will receive A$5,678.59 for each 500,000-yen bond held at maturity.
The coupon will be paid in yen, while redemption will be in Australian dollars.
The breakdown of the terms is as follows.
AMT 30 bln yen COUPON 5.6% MATURITY Sept 28, 1998
TYPE yen/A$ samuari ISS PRICE 100 yen PAY DATE Sept 27, 1996
NOTE: Syndicate members are Daiwa Securities, Nikko Securities, Yamaichi Securities and Kokusai Securities.
